summary: Crash when clicking "Presets" after setting the superflat preset with a non-existent biome
description: Crash when you click "Presets" after replacing the "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu I was creating a world called "Nether" with Superflat, I replaced "minecraft:plains" to "minecraft:the_nether" to see if the piglins won t turn to zombified piglins, I clicked "Done" and clicked "Presets" again to see if "minecraft:the_nether" doesn t has turn onto "minecraft:plains" again, and The Game Crashed What I expected to happen was: When I click presets after replacing it, it should resets to default. What happened was: It crashed after I press presets. How to reproduce: Create a new world in Superflat click on Customize, after click on Presets replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu after click on Done and Presets again and see if it crash(If you press cancel it won t crash)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Superflat world.
2. Click on "Customize" in the world creation menu.
3. In the customization menu, click on "Presets".
4. Replace "minecraft:plains" with a non-existent biome, such as "minecraft:the_nether".
5. Click "Done" to apply the changes.
6. Immediately after clicking "Done", click on "Presets" again.
7. Observe if the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4
Observed Behavior: When attempting to click "Presets" after replacing the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome like "minecraft:the_nether" in the Superflat customization menu, the game crashes immediately upon pressing "Presets." The expectation was that clicking on "Presets" would reset the settings to default values. However, instead of resetting or displaying an error message, the game crashes completely. To reproduce this issue, create a new world with the Superflat preset, customize it by replacing "minecraft:plains" with any non-existent biome name, and then proceed to click on "Presets." The crash occurs only when clicking "Presets"; pressing cancel avoids the crash entirely. This behavior is specific to using non-existent biomes in the customization menu and attempting to navigate back to the presets after making such a change.
Expected Behavior: When clicking "Presets" after replacing the biome with a non-existent one in the superflat customization menu, the game should reset the biome settings to default without crashing. The user should be able to navigate back and forth between customizing and presets seamlessly.
